mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = f.revision_id AND r.relation_type = 'REQUESTS' AND r.from_kind = 'FILE' AND r.from_id = 'F' || f.file_id)) AS "noRequest" FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.file_type IN ('JSP', 'WEBSQUARE', 'NEXACRO')

SELECT f.path FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.file_type IN ('JSP', 'WEBSQUARE', 'NEXACRO') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = f.revision_id AND r.relation_type = 'REQUESTS' AND r.from_kind = 'FILE' AND r.from_id = 'F' || f.file_id) ORDER BY f.path LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT endpoint_type AS "endpointType" , COUNT(*) AS "count" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE method_id IS NULL) AS "noMethod" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = e.revision_id AND r.relation_type = 'REQUESTS' AND r.to_id = e.method_id)) AS "notRequested" FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY endpoint_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT e.endpoint_type AS "endpointType", e.path AS "path", f.path AS "file", e.line_start AS "line" , COALESCE(e.properties_json->>'unresolvedClass', e.properties_json->>'unresolvedMethod', e.properties_json->>'actionClass') AS "note" FROM analysis_endpoint e JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = e.file_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND e.method_id IS NULL AND e.endpoint_type NOT IN ('JSP', 'SERVLET') ORDER BY f.path, e.line_start LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT regexp_replace(path, '^.*/', '') AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "count", MIN(path) AS "example" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND file_type = 'XML' GROUP BY regexp_replace(path, '^.*/', '') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND file_type = 'XML'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE layer IS NULL) AS "noLayer" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE layer_confidence = 'LOW') AS "low" FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND kind = 'CLASS'

SELECT COALESCE(package_name, '(기본 패키지)') AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "count", MIN(simple_name) AS "example" FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND kind = 'CLASS' AND layer IS NULL GROUP BY package_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT name FROM analysis_resource WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND resource_type = 'RULE_SET' ORDER BY resource_id
